admission.justification: A resolving link can still be a second pointer for one action, a unique pointer can still dangle, and agreeing steps say nothing about either; only together does an agent find one working pointer at each action with honest receipt metadata.

guarantee: Every link and anchor that the l-01 skill delivers resolves in the source and in the packaged copy; each native first message carries one pointer per action; the manifest's declared step for a detail names exactly the actions of the pointers to that file; and no core unit links the every-role place that projects it.
title: Delivered l-01 pointers resolve, and each action has one
